facts.text: The resort is set in Mexico's coastal rainforest.

facts.text: The Riviera Nayarit resort has emerald cliffs, palm-fringed sands, lagoons and estuaries, on an unspoiled stretch of coast with a swimmable beach.

facts.text: The resort is about an hour from Puerto Vallarta International Airport by luxury SUV or Sprinter.
